Zubair Ahmed  
Tel Aviv, Israel | +972-52-345-6789 | zubair.ahmed@example.com | linkedin.com/in/zubairahmed | github.com/zubairahmed  

Over the past four years, I’ve specialized in designing and implementing security frameworks for startups and mid-sized enterprises. My work spans from foundational security audits to advanced threat modeling, with a focus on aligning technical solutions with business objectives. At CyberShield Consulting, I lead engagements that balance proactive risk mitigation with operational efficiency, ensuring compliance and resilience across distributed systems. Prior roles have included architecting IAM solutions for SaaS platforms, optimizing encryption protocols for cloud workloads, and spearheading SOC2 compliance projects. My approach emphasizes measurable outcomes, often translating into reduced breach response times, streamlined audit processes, and enhanced access control models.  

Technical Skills / Technologies  
Core competencies include designing and managing identity and access management (IAM) systems, implementing encryption protocols for data-at-rest and in-transit, and conducting penetration tests to identify vulnerabilities. I’ve architected zero-trust frameworks that reduced unauthorized access attempts by 40% in a SaaS environment. My work with PKI infrastructure involved managing certificate lifecycles for 15+ cloud services, ensuring compliance with industry standards. I’ve also integrated TCP/IP-based monitoring tools to detect anomalous traffic patterns, contributing to a 30% improvement in incident detection rates. Network security initiatives have focused on mitigating DDoS risks and securing API gateways, with a particular emphasis on application-layer defenses.  

Languages  
English (fluent), Hebrew (proficient)  

Projects / Side Projects  
- **SOC2 Compliance Optimization**: Spearheaded a 12-week project to align SecureNet Solutions’ infrastructure with SOC2 standards, reducing audit remediation time by 25% and eliminating 18 critical control gaps.  
- **Zero-Trust IAM Framework**: Developed a scalable IAM system for a mid-sized fintech startup, integrating multi-factor authentication and role-based access controls that cut unauthorized access attempts by 40%.  
- **Cloud Encryption Latency Reduction**: Refactored encryption protocols for a distributed database, reducing latency by 20% while maintaining compliance with GDPR and HIPAA.  
- **Penetration Testing Automation**: Built a custom toolchain to automate vulnerability scanning, improving test coverage by 35% and enabling faster remediation cycles for 15+ clients.

- Certified Information Security Manager (CISM)  
- Offensive Security Certified Professional (OSCP)
